fusions.name: Skip the Line
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 6 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 70% of that. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Host-Hopper
fusions.desc: Looses a fan of arrows 5 tiles ahead that deals 12 damage to everything in it and leaves each one [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Out of Reach
fusions.desc: Springs you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Hop and Loose
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.
